Finite-family multiscale selector audit at the exact quantifiers in OpenAI September 23, 2026, selector.tex.

definitions.p-small: An integral containment cover G has sum_{S in G} p^|S| <= 1/2.
definitions.mass: For each nonempty H in F, lambda_H is a nonnegative real probability mass on finite X, vanishing off H.
definitions.profile: n_ih counts vertices with final color i and original color h>i; crossings m_i=sum_{j<=i<h} n_jh.
definitions.baseline: Primary-source antecedents are contextual only; no companion manuscript theorem is assumed.

contexts.statement: Staged OpenAI discrete-convexity manuscript, September 23, 2026; claims remain unverified.

definitions.E_k(D): Sets S not contained in any union of k members of D; repetitions allowed.
definitions.p-small: An integral containment cover of cost at most 1/2 at p.

contexts.statement: Staged OpenAI graph-decomposition manuscript, October 5, 2026; companion discrete-convexity is an unresolved dependency.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 175 (Talagrand’s expectation thresholds, discrete convexity, and graph decompositions.; papers: Graph Decompositions at the Integral Expectation Threshold; Integral and fractional expectation thresholds are equivalent; Talagrand’s discrete-convexity conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/175.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Primary-source baseline: Pham arXiv:2412.03540v1 Theorem 1.3 and Sections 2.1-2.2 give single-scale capture and minimum towers; BMM arXiv:2212.14636v3 Lemma 3.6 gives a maximal truncation antecedent. Neither cited statement is assumed to imply a common member at all scales. Sources were obtained and read; comprehensive novelty remains unchecked.

For finite X, nonempty F of nonempty subsets not p-small (0<p<=1), arbitrary supported probability masses, D=256 and any integer s>=0 with p sum_{i=1}^s D^i<=1/2, independent colors pi_i=D^i p and residual pi_{s+1} simultaneously capture lambda_H(A_i)>=1-2^-i for some single H, all i<=s, with probability >=9/10; the same H has mean color <=2. Source: selector.tex thm:multiscale-selector.

For any probability mass lambda on finite X, A subset X, real m>=0 and 0<d<1, a nonempty admissible-cutoff set in [0,1] has a largest epsilon, and d*|{lambda>epsilon}|<=m. Admissibility is inclusion {lambda>u} subset A and sum min(lambda,u)(1_A-(1-d))>=m*u. Source: selector.tex sel:truncation.

For each original coloring a and H0 in F, a feasible earlier-color move of minimum length with changed set in H0 exists; distinct selected final colorings yield changed sets covering F. Bad colorings have no feasible unchanged move. Duplicate changed sets do not reduce the sum indexed by distinct colorings below the deduplicated cover cost. Source: selector.tex sel:feasibility through sel:cover-cost.

Fix a selected final coloring z and full profile. These data determine all crossing charges. Any one witness feasible for these data, with independently maximal cutoffs, works for every selected original coloring in the fiber. Its high-weight sets contain all vertices changed to the corresponding final color. Proof must derive this by the one-level-delay contradiction, not assume a reconstruction inequality. Source: selector.tex sel:profile-crossings through sel:changed-vertices.

For fixed z and profile with row sums t_i and high-weight sets R_i, the number of original selected colorings is at most product_i binom(|R_i|,t_i) multinomial(t_i;(n_ih)_{h>i}), even if R_i overlap. Also p^t P(a)=P(z) product_i(p/pi_i)^t_i product_{i<h}pi_h^n_ih. Source: selector.tex sel:encoding-bound and sel:likelihood.

The original entropy/profile summation gives (1/2)Pr(bad) <= sum_{nonzero integer tuples t_i>=0} product_i(e/64^i)^t_i <1/20, so Pr(bad)<=1/10. Source: selector.tex sel:entropy-bound through sel:tuple-sum and geometric tail.

Conditional on SEL175, equal distribution of nonempty fractional-set mass among vertices, the selector event, and independent variables Y_x=B^(4-a(x)) give E Z>=9/40 and E Z<=1/10 if F is not r/(25*512^4)-small. Source: rounding.tex round:mass, round:lower, round:mean, round:upper.

For every finite nonempty X and nonempty proper increasing F, q_f(F)<=25*512^4 q(F), with budget 1/2 and no support-cardinality restriction. Source: introduction.tex thm:main; depends on the selector and rounding proof, not treated as an assumption.

For finite X, 0<rho<1, 1<=r<=h, h>=64, and H subset binom(X,r) with |H|rho^r<=2^(h+1), the sets containing at least 2^(12h) members of H have a rho-cover of cost <=3*2^-h. Source: sections/01_covering.tex lem:covering.

For S in E_32(F), b(U) defined in sections/02_weights.tex eq:weights-definition satisfies 0=sum_{U subset S}(-1)^|U| b(U)^32; Parseval gives sum_U q^|U| b(U)^2<=1 and exceptional sets have sum_{nonempty U subset S}b(U)^32>=2^-32. Source: eq:signed-identity, eq:global-weight-bound, eq:exceptional-weight-bound. Unverified manuscript assertions.
With L=2^70, every N>=1, q in (0,1), and F subset 2^[N] with mu_q(F)>=1/2 have E_32(F) (q/L)-small. Source: sections/02_weights.tex prop:half-density; depends on DC_COVER175 and DC_SIGNED175.

With L=2^70, k=32L, and mu_p(D)>=1-1/k, coordinatewise exclusive labels couple L mu_p rows to a mu_(Lp) union when Lp<1. The union family F has measure >=31/32 and E_32(F)=E_k(D). When Lp>=1 a mandatory-row coupling gives rows of density p whose union is [N], so E_k(D) is empty. Source: sections/03_density.tex.

For k=2^75, every N>=1, p in (0,1), and arbitrary D subset 2^[N] with mu_p(D)>=1-1/k have E_k(D) p-small. Source: sections/00_intro.tex thm:main. Unverified companion claim, not an assumption for selector work.
Conditional on DC_MAIN175: if q(H;n)<r<1 and mu_r(D)>=1-1/(2^75), some labelled H lies in the union of 2^75 members of D. Source: main.tex thm:discrete and cor:typical-cover.

For nonempty H, q(H;n)>=1/(2 binom(n,2)) and q(H;n)>=(1/2)n^(-2/degen(H)); a d-degenerate graph partitions into m graphs of degeneracy <=ceil(d/m); subgraph thresholds are monotone. Source: main.tex lem:q-lower, lem:split, eq:monotonicity.

For 0<r<1, integer s>=1 and nonempty R subset {T subset Y:1<=|T|<=s}, some nonempty Q subset R has size <=ceil(2r^-s), and every S satisfying R has f_Q(S)>=1/2, for smoothed test eq:smoothed-test. Source: main.tex lem:compression. Unverified.

For sufficiently large n, 0<r<1, s<=10 log n and r^s>=n^-1/100, there is a graph family D of mu_r-measure >=1-1/(2^75) such that each supported bipartite J across |Y|<=n^(2/3), with <=n/8 positive-degree outside vertices and outside degrees <=s, has p_c(J;n)<=1-(1-r)^32<=32r. Source: main.tex prop:transfer; uses compression and Hall tests. Unverified.

For sufficiently large n and transfer parameter conditions, a graph J with <=n/4 positive-degree vertices, degeneracy <=s and maximum degree <=n^(2/3) has p_c(J;n)<=r. Source: main.tex prop:degree-embedding. Unverified.
For A=400e^4 and sufficiently large n, star forest J with <=n/100 positive-degree vertices has p_c(J;n)<=2Aq(J;n), strengthened to Aq(J;n) if q(J;n)<1/(2A). Source: main.tex prop:stars. Unverified.

Absolute k>=2,L>=1 exist so that every graph H on <=n vertices, n>=2, has a deterministic edge partition into k graphs H_i with p_c(H_i;n)<=Lq(H;n). Source: main.tex thm:main; constants k=2*(2^75)*1000*1001^2, L=max{800e^4,64,n0^2}; relies on companion discrete convexity, transfer, degree embedding and star forests. Unverified.

Universal arbitrary-palette selector theorem: for s>=0, 0<d_i<1, positive independent color probabilities pi summing to one, non-p-small F and arbitrary supported probability masses, define q_i=sum_{h>i}pi_h and R=sum_i p*q_i/(d_i*pi_i). For bad=no common member meeting all capture targets, (1/2)Pr(bad)<=sum_{t=1}^{|X|}(t^t/t!)*R^t. If 3R<1, Pr(bad)<=2R/(1-3R). Proof: research/selector_certificate/proof.md; reconstruction and counting are derived, not assumed.

Universal reconstruction core: for any finite X, natural-number colorings a,z with z<=a, finite witness family, weights and real cutoffs, every feasible common witness for a minimum-length move forces each vertex moved to color i into the strict high-weight set at i. A shared full crossing profile transfers feasibility to every original coloring in the fiber. The result is derived from one-level delay, exact crossing-charge change and minimality, with no reconstruction assumption.

Under the manuscript selector hypotheses with d_i=2^-i and geometric palette pi_i=D^i*p, D>8, bad probability is <4/(D-8) for s>=1 and zero for s=0. Thus D=48 gives success >=9/10; the original D=256 gives success >=61/62. The same member has mean color <=2.

For finite nonempty X and nonempty proper increasing F, q_f(F)<=25*96^4*q(F), with the same budget 1/2. This follows by the universal selector with D=48, B=96 and the independently spelled-out expectation comparison in proof.md. This is a candidate numerical strengthening, not an independently reviewed novelty claim.

Universal reconstruction core: for any finite X, natural-number colorings a,z with z<=a, finite witness family, weights and real cutoffs, every feasible common witness for a minimum-length move forces each vertex moved to color i into the strict high-weight set at i. A shared full crossing profile transfers feasibility to every original coloring in the fiber. The result is derived from one-level delay, exact crossing-charge change and minimality, with no reconstruction assumption.

import Mathlib

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace SelectorCertificate

variable {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

def totalCap (w : X → ℝ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, min (w x) u

def capturedCap (w : X → ℝ) (z : X → ℕ) (i : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, if z x ≤ i then min (w x) u else 0

def crossings (a z : X → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, if z x ≤ i ∧ i < a x then 1 else 0

def slack (w : X → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (a z : X → ℕ) (i : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  capturedCap w z i u - (1 - d) * totalCap w u - crossings a z i * u

def FeasibleWith (s : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)
    (a z : X → ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, z x ≤ a x) ∧
  ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ s →
    0 ≤ u i ∧ u i ≤ 1 ∧
    (∀ x, u i < w x → z x ≤ i) ∧
    0 ≤ slack w (d i) a z i (u i)

def moveLength (a z : X → ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ x, (a x - z x)

def ChangesIn (H₀ : Set X) (a z : X → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, z x < a x → x ∈ H₀

def HasWitness {T : Type*} (valid : T → Prop) (weight : T → X → ℝ)
    (s : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ) (a z : X → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, 1 ≤ z x) ∧ ∃ h, valid h ∧ ∃ u, FeasibleWith s d (weight h) a z u

def Minimal {T : Type*} (valid : T → Prop) (weight : T → X → ℝ)
    (s : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ) (a : X → ℕ) (H₀ : Set X) (z : X → ℕ) : Prop :=
  HasWitness valid weight s d a z ∧ ChangesIn H₀ a z ∧
  ∀ z', HasWitness valid weight s d a z' → ChangesIn H₀ a z' →
    moveLength a z ≤ moveLength a z'

def delay (z : X → ℕ) (x : X) : X → ℕ :=
  Function.update z x (z x + 1)

theorem capturedCap_delay (w : X → ℝ) (z : X → ℕ)
    (x : X) (i : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    capturedCap w (delay z x) i u =
      capturedCap w z i u - if z x = i then min (w x) u else 0 := by
  classical
  have hp (y : X) :
      (if delay z x y ≤ i then min (w y) u else 0) =
      (if z y ≤ i then min (w y) u else 0) -
        (if y = x then (if z x = i then min (w x) u else 0) else 0) := by
    by_cases hy : y = x
    · subst y
      simp only [delay, Function.update_self]
      by_cases hi : z x = i
      · subst i
        simp
      · have hh : (z x + 1 ≤ i) ↔ (z x ≤ i) := by omega
        simp [hi, hh]
    · simp [delay, hy]
  unfold capturedCap
  simp_rw [hp]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp

theorem crossings_delay (a z : X → ℕ) (x : X) (i : ℕ)
    (hx : z x < a x) :
    crossings a (delay z x) i =
      crossings a z i - if z x = i then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  have hp (y : X) :
      (if delay z x y ≤ i ∧ i < a y then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      (if z y ≤ i ∧ i < a y then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
        (if y = x then (if z x = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) else 0) := by
    by_cases hy : y = x
    · subst y
      simp only [delay, Function.update_self]
      by_cases hi : z x = i
      · subst i
        simp [hx]
      · have hh : (z x + 1 ≤ i) ↔ (z x ≤ i) := by omega
        simp [hi, hh]
    · simp [delay, hy]
  unfold crossings
  simp_rw [hp]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp

theorem moveLength_delay (a z : X → ℕ) (x : X) (hx : z x < a x) :
    moveLength a (delay z x) + 1 = moveLength a z := by
  classical
  have hp (y : X) :
      (a y - delay z x y) + (if y = x then 1 else 0) = a y - z y := by
    by_cases hy : y = x
    · subst y
      simpa [delay] using
        (show (a x - (z x + 1)) + 1 = a x - z x from by omega)
    · simp [delay, hy]
  have hsum := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun y _ => hp y)
  simpa [moveLength, Finset.sum_add_distrib] using hsum

omit [Fintype X] in
theorem delay_le (a z : X → ℕ) (x : X)
    (hza : ∀ y, z y ≤ a y) (hx : z x < a x) :
    ∀ y, delay z x y ≤ a y := by
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y = x
  · subst y
    simp only [delay, Function.update_self]
    omega
  · simpa [delay, Function.update_of_ne hy] using hza y

omit [Fintype X] in
theorem changesIn_delay (H₀ : Set X) (a z : X → ℕ) (x : X)
    (hc : ChangesIn H₀ a z) : ChangesIn H₀ a (delay z x) := by
  intro y hy
  apply hc y
  by_cases hxy : y = x
  · subst y
    simp only [delay, Function.update_self] at hy
    omega
  · simpa [delay, Function.update_of_ne hxy] using hy

theorem feasible_delay (s : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)
    (a z : X → ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (x : X)
    (hf : FeasibleWith s d w a z u) (hx : z x < a x)
    (hsmall : w x ≤ u (z x)) :
    FeasibleWith s d w a (delay z x) u := by
  classical
  refine ⟨delay_le a z x hf.1 hx, ?_⟩
  intro i hi his
  obtain ⟨hu0, hu1, hinc, hslack⟩ := hf.2 i hi his
  refine ⟨hu0, hu1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    by_cases hxy : y = x
    · subst y
      have hzi := hinc x hy
      have hne : z x ≠ i := by
        intro he
        subst i
        exact (not_lt_of_ge hsmall) hy
      simp only [delay, Function.update_self]
      omega
    · simpa [delay, Function.update_of_ne hxy] using hinc y hy
  · have hs :
        slack w (d i) a (delay z x) i (u i) =
        slack w (d i) a z i (u i) +
          if z x = i then u i - min (w x) (u i) else 0 := by
      unfold slack
      rw [capturedCap_delay, crossings_delay a z x i hx]
      by_cases he : z x = i <;> simp only [he, if_true, if_false] <;> ring
    rw [hs]
    split_ifs
    · linarith [min_le_right (w x) (u i)]
    · simpa using hslack

theorem minimal_forces_high {T : Type*} (valid : T → Prop)
    (weight : T → X → ℝ) (s : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (a z : X → ℕ) (H₀ : Set X)
    (hm : Minimal valid weight s d a H₀ z)
    (h : T) (hv : valid h) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : FeasibleWith s d (weight h) a z u)
    (x : X) (_hi : 1 ≤ z x) (_his : z x ≤ s) (hx : z x < a x) :
    u (z x) < weight h x := by
  by_contra hn
  have hsmall : weight h x ≤ u (z x) := le_of_not_gt hn
  have hf' := feasible_delay s d (weight h) a z u x hf hx hsmall
  have hpos : ∀ y, 1 ≤ delay z x y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y = x
    · subst y
      simp only [delay, Function.update_self]
      omega
    · simpa [delay, Function.update_of_ne hy] using hm.1.1 y
  have hmin := hm.2.2 (delay z x) ⟨hpos, h, hv, u, hf'⟩
    (changesIn_delay H₀ a z x hm.2.1)
  have hlen := moveLength_delay a z x hx
  omega

def cell (a z : X → ℕ) (j h : ℕ) : Finset X :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x => z x = j ∧ a x = h)

def profile (a z : X → ℕ) (j h : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (cell a z j h).card

def crossingPairs (B i : ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  ((Finset.range (B + 1)).product (Finset.range (B + 1))).filter
    (fun jh => jh.1 ≤ i ∧ i < jh.2)

omit [DecidableEq X] in
theorem crossings_eq_profile (a z : X → ℕ) (B i : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ x, a x ≤ B) (hz : ∀ x, z x ≤ B) :
    crossings a z i =
      ∑ jh ∈ crossingPairs B i, (profile a z jh.1 jh.2 : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have h := Finset.sum_fiberwise_eq_sum_filter
    (Finset.univ : Finset X) (crossingPairs B i)
    (fun x => (z x, a x)) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  have hl :
      (∑ jh ∈ crossingPairs B i,
        ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (z x, a x) = jh), (1 : ℝ)) =
      ∑ jh ∈ crossingPairs B i, (profile a z jh.1 jh.2 : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro jh _
    rcases jh with ⟨j, h⟩
    simp [profile, cell, Prod.mk.injEq]
  have hr :
      (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun x => (z x, a x) ∈ crossingPairs B i), (1 : ℝ)) =
      crossings a z i := by
    unfold crossings
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    have hza : z x < B + 1 := by have := hz x; omega
    have haa : a x < B + 1 := by have := ha x; omega
    simp [crossingPairs, hza, haa]
  exact hr.symm.trans (h.symm.trans hl)

omit [DecidableEq X] in
theorem same_profile_crossings (a b z : X → ℕ) (B : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ x, a x ≤ B) (hb : ∀ x, b x ≤ B) (hz : ∀ x, z x ≤ B)
    (hp : ∀ j h, j < h → profile a z j h = profile b z j h) :
    ∀ i, crossings a z i = crossings b z i := by
  intro i
  rw [crossings_eq_profile a z B i ha hz, crossings_eq_profile b z B i hb hz]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro jh hjh
  have hc := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hjh).2
  have hjh' : jh.1 < jh.2 := by omega
  rw [hp jh.1 jh.2 hjh']

omit [DecidableEq X] in
theorem feasible_same_crossings (s : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)
    (a b z : X → ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : FeasibleWith s d w a z u)
    (hzb : ∀ x, z x ≤ b x)
    (hc : ∀ i, crossings a z i = crossings b z i) :
    FeasibleWith s d w b z u := by
  refine ⟨hzb, ?_⟩
  intro i hi his
  obtain ⟨hu0, hu1, hinc, hs⟩ := hf.2 i hi his
  refine ⟨hu0, hu1, hinc, ?_⟩
  simpa only [slack, ← hc i] using hs

theorem common_witness_reconstruction {T : Type*} (valid : T → Prop)
    (weight : T → X → ℝ) (s B : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ)
    (a b z : X → ℕ) (H₀ : Set X)
    (hm : Minimal valid weight s d b H₀ z)
    (ha : ∀ x, a x ≤ B) (hb : ∀ x, b x ≤ B) (hz : ∀ x, z x ≤ B)
    (hzb : ∀ x, z x ≤ b x)
    (hp : ∀ j h, j < h → profile a z j h = profile b z j h)
    (h : T) (hv : valid h) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : FeasibleWith s d (weight h) a z u) :
    FeasibleWith s d (weight h) b z u ∧
    ∀ x, 1 ≤ z x → z x ≤ s → z x < b x → u (z x) < weight h x := by
  have hf' := feasible_same_crossings s d (weight h) a b z u hf hzb
    (same_profile_crossings a b z B ha hb hz hp)
  exact ⟨hf', fun x hi his hx =>
    minimal_forces_high valid weight s d b z H₀ hm h hv u hf' x hi his hx⟩

omit [DecidableEq X] in
theorem encoding_injective (a b z : X → ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ x, z x ≤ a x) (hb : ∀ x, z x ≤ b x)
    (he : ∀ i h, i < h → cell a z i h = cell b z i h) : a = b := by
  funext x
  by_cases hax : z x < a x
  · have hm : x ∈ cell a z (z x) (a x) := by simp [cell]
    rw [he (z x) (a x) hax] at hm
    exact ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2.2).symm
  · by_cases hbx : z x < b x
    · have hm : x ∈ cell b z (z x) (b x) := by simp [cell]
      rw [← he (z x) (b x) hbx] at hm
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2.2
    · have := ha x
      have := hb x
      omega

def capScore (w : X → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (A : Finset X) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, min (w x) u * ((if x ∈ A then 1 else 0) - (1 - d))

def cutoffSet (w : X → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (A : Finset X) (m : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  Set.Icc 0 1 ∩
    ({u | ∀ x, x ∉ A → w x ≤ u} ∩ {u | 0 ≤ capScore w d A u - m * u})

def highSet (w : X → ℝ) (u : ℝ) : Finset X :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x => u < w x)

theorem capScore_cumulative (w : X → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (z : X → ℕ)
    (i : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    capScore w d (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => z x ≤ i)) u =
      capturedCap w z i u - (1 - d) * totalCap w u := by
  unfold capScore capturedCap totalCap
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  split_ifs <;> ring

theorem untruncation_capture (w : X → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (A : Finset X) (u : ℝ)
    (hwsum : ∑ x, w x = 1) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hinc : ∀ x, u < w x → x ∈ A)
    (hs : 0 ≤ capScore w d A u) :
    1 - d ≤ ∑ x ∈ A, w x := by
  have hsum :
      capScore w d A u ≤
      ∑ x, w x * ((if x ∈ A then 1 else 0) - (1 - d)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro x _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A
    · simp only [hx, if_true, sub_sub_cancel]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left (w x) u) hd
    · have hwu : w x ≤ u := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hx (hinc x (lt_of_not_ge hn))
      rw [min_eq_left hwu]
  have heq :
      (∑ x, w x * ((if x ∈ A then 1 else 0) - (1 - d))) =
      (∑ x ∈ A, w x) - (1 - d) := by
    have hp (x : X) :
        w x * ((if x ∈ A then 1 else 0) - (1 - d)) =
        (if x ∈ A then w x else 0) - w x * (1 - d) := by
      split_ifs <;> ring
    simp_rw [hp]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hwsum]
    simp [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [heq] at hsum
  linarith

theorem unchanged_capture (s : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)
    (a : X → ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hwsum : ∑ x, w x = 1)
    (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ s → 0 ≤ d i)
    (hf : FeasibleWith s d w a a u) :
    ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ s →
      1 - d i ≤ ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => a x ≤ i), w x := by
  intro i hi his
  obtain ⟨_, _, hinc, hs⟩ := hf.2 i hi his
  have hc : crossings a a i = 0 := by
    unfold crossings
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x _
    have hn : ¬ (a x ≤ i ∧ i < a x) := by omega
    simp [hn]
  apply untruncation_capture w (d i)
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => a x ≤ i)) (u i) hwsum (hd i hi his)
  · intro x hx
    simpa using hinc x hx
  · rw [capScore_cumulative]
    simpa only [slack, hc, zero_mul, sub_zero] using hs

theorem maximal_cutoff_exists (w : X → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (A : Finset X) (m : ℝ)
    (hne : (cutoffSet w d A m).Nonempty) :
    ∃ u, IsGreatest (cutoffSet w d A m) u := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun u => capScore w d A u - m * u) := by
    unfold capScore
    fun_prop
  have hi : IsClosed {u : ℝ | ∀ x, x ∉ A → w x ≤ u} := by
    have he :
        {u : ℝ | ∀ x, x ∉ A → w x ≤ u} =
        ⋂ x : X, ⋂ _h : x ∉ A, {u : ℝ | w x ≤ u} := by
      ext u
      simp
    rw [he]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun x =>
      isClosed_iInter fun _ => isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_id
  have hs : IsClosed {u : ℝ | 0 ≤ capScore w d A u - m * u} :=
    isClosed_le continuous_const hc
  exact (isCompact_Icc.inter_right (hi.inter hs)).exists_isGreatest hne

theorem maximal_cutoff_count (w : X → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (A : Finset X) (m u : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, w x ≤ 1) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hu : IsGreatest (cutoffSet w d A m) u) :
    d * (highSet w u).card ≤ m := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨hu0, hu1⟩, hinc, hs⟩ := hu.1
  change 0 ≤ capScore w d A u - m * u at hs
  by_cases huone : u = 1
  · have hempty : highSet w u = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro x hx
      have hx' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      have := hw x
      rw [huone] at hx'
      linarith
    simpa [hempty] using hm
  · have hu_lt : u < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hu1 huone
    let C : Finset ℝ :=
      (insert 1 (Finset.univ.image w)).filter (fun v => u < v)
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ C := by simp [C, hu_lt]
    have hC : C.Nonempty := ⟨1, h1⟩
    let v := C.min' hC
    have hv_mem : v ∈ C := Finset.min'_mem C hC
    have huv : u < v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv_mem).2
    have hv1 : v ≤ 1 := Finset.min'_le C 1 h1
    have hvw : ∀ x, u < w x → v ≤ w x := by
      intro x hx
      apply Finset.min'_le C (w x)
      simp [C, hx]
    have hinA : ∀ x, u < w x → x ∈ A := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hn
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (hinc x hn)) hx
    have hdiff :
        capScore w d A v - capScore w d A u =
        (v - u) * d * (highSet w u).card := by
      unfold capScore
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have hp (x : X) :
          min (w x) v * ((if x ∈ A then 1 else 0) - (1 - d)) -
            min (w x) u * ((if x ∈ A then 1 else 0) - (1 - d)) =
          if u < w x then (v - u) * d else 0 := by
        by_cases hx : u < w x
        · rw [min_eq_right (hvw x hx), min_eq_right (le_of_lt hx)]
          simp only [hinA x hx, if_true, hx]
          ring
        · have hwxu : w x ≤ u := le_of_not_gt hx
          rw [min_eq_left (le_trans hwxu (le_of_lt huv)), min_eq_left hwxu]
          simp [hx]
      simp_rw [hp]
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      unfold highSet
      ring
    by_contra hn
    have hbad : m < d * (highSet w u).card := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hvmem : v ∈ cutoffSet w d A m := by
      refine ⟨⟨le_trans hu0 (le_of_lt huv), hv1⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        exact le_trans (hinc x hx) (le_of_lt huv)
      · change 0 ≤ capScore w d A v - m * v
        have hpos := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr huv) (sub_pos.mpr hbad)
        nlinarith
    have := hu.2 hvmem
    linarith

theorem power_ratio_le_three (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n ≤ 3 * (n : ℝ) ^ n := by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by omega)
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ hb0 (Real.add_one_le_exp (1 / (n : ℝ))) n
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at hp
  have he : (n : ℝ) * (1 / (n : ℝ)) = 1 := by field_simp
  rw [he] at hp
  have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 := le_of_lt (by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9])
  have hmajor : (1 / (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n ≤ 3 := le_trans hp hexp
  have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmajor (le_of_lt (pow_pos hn0 n))
  have hmul :
      (1 / (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n * (n : ℝ) ^ n = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  simpa only [hmul] using hprod

theorem factorial_majorant (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * 3 ^ (n - 1) := by
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => norm_num
  | succ n hn ih =>
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hpow := power_ratio_le_three n hn
    have he : (3 : ℝ) ^ n = 3 * 3 ^ (n - 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show n = (n - 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      ring
    have hstep :
        ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) ≤
        ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (n.factorial : ℝ) * 3 ^ n := calc
      ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) =
          ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (3 * (n : ℝ) ^ n) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hn0
      _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (3 * ((n.factorial : ℝ) * 3 ^ (n - 1))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by norm_num)) hn0
      _ = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (n.factorial : ℝ) * 3 ^ n := by rw [he]; ring
    simpa only [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hstep

theorem factorial_profile_sum {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I]
    (C : Finset I) (r : I → ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ C.piAntidiag t,
      ((t : ℝ) ^ t / (t.factorial : ℝ)) *
        (Nat.multinomial C n : ℝ) * ∏ c ∈ C, r c ^ n c) =
    ((t : ℝ) ^ t / (t.factorial : ℝ)) * (∑ c ∈ C, r c) ^ t := by
  rw [Finset.sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  ring

theorem finite_geometric_bound (q : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ k) ≤ 1 / (1 - q) := by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1 - q)).2
  have hg := geom_sum_mul q N
  have hp := pow_nonneg hq0 N
  nlinarith

def profilePolynomial (N : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
    (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ)) * R ^ (k + 1)

theorem profile_polynomial_bound (N : ℕ) (R : ℝ)
    (hR0 : 0 ≤ R) (hR : 3 * R < 1) :
    profilePolynomial N R ≤ R / (1 - 3 * R) := by
  have hsum :
      profilePolynomial N R ≤
      R * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (3 * R) ^ k := by
    unfold profilePolynomial
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k _
    have hfpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k + 1).factorial :=
      by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos (k + 1)
    have hcoef :
        ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≤
        (3 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hfpos).2
      simpa [mul_comm] using factorial_majorant (k + 1) (by omega)
    have hterm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef (pow_nonneg hR0 (k + 1))
    calc
      _ ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ k * R ^ (k + 1) := hterm
      _ = R * (3 * R) ^ k := by rw [mul_pow, pow_succ]; ring
  have hg := finite_geometric_bound (3 * R) N (by positivity) hR
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg hR0
  exact le_trans hsum (by simpa only [mul_one_div] using hh)

theorem original_palette_bound (R bad : ℝ)
    (_hR0 : 0 ≤ R) (hR : R < 1 / 127)
    (hbad : bad ≤ 2 * R / (1 - 3 * R)) : bad < 1 / 62 := by
  have hden : 0 < 1 - 3 * R := by linarith
  have hb : 2 * R / (1 - 3 * R) < (1 : ℝ) / 62 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hden).2
    linarith
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hbad hb

theorem improved_palette_bound (R bad : ℝ)
    (_hR0 : 0 ≤ R) (hR : R < 1 / 23)
    (hbad : bad ≤ 2 * R / (1 - 3 * R)) : bad < 1 / 10 := by
  have hden : 0 < 1 - 3 * R := by linarith
  have hb : 2 * R / (1 - 3 * R) < (1 : ℝ) / 10 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hden).2
    linarith
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hbad hb

claims.natural_statement: Factorial full-profile summation: after deriving common-witness reconstruction and encoding, a fixed z/profile with t>0 contributes at most P(z)*t^t*product_{i<h}[(p*pi_h/(d_i*pi_i))^n_ih/n_ih!]. Summing all profiles of total t is exactly P(z)*(t^t/t!)*R^t. Universally t^t/t!<=3^(t-1), so the finite polynomial is <=R/(1-3R) when R>=0 and 3R<1. Proof.md contains the counting-to-coefficient conversion; Main.lean proves the multinomial identity and universal factorial/geometric estimates.
